Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back for the evening session. The Zimbabwean openers will be out soon to begin their second innings. It's Prince Masvaure who has Craig Ervine as the partner. Kevin Kasuza got injured early this morning and suffered a concussion. We are hearing that Timycen Maruma is the concussion substitute. Suranga Lakmal to kickoff proceedings. 32 overs left in the day's play.
... DAY 3, THIRD SESSION ...

Tea has been taken on Day 3! Zimbabwe will be oozing with confidence and would like to transfer that into their batting innings. They are effectively 113/0 and would hope to bat the Lankans out of the match. Do join us in a short while for the evening session!

Zimbabwe were brilliant in the field, especially today. They did look off-colour last afternoon but didn't waste much time in striking the right chord. Carl Mumba and Victor Nyauchi were impressive in their spells while Donald Tiripano did superbly to tie one end up. Debutant Tinotenda Mutombodzi was a major disappointment on a helpful wicket but still Zimbabwe would be hopeful that he gets his rhythm right in the second essay.

Replying to Zimbabwe's big first innings' total, the Lankan openers put together a 94-run stand to lay the foundation. But since the Tea break on Day 2, the hosts got good control on the game mainly due to the efficient bowling by Sikandar Raza. The offie kept on pegging the Lankans back at regular intervals. Angelo Mathews and Dhananjaya did form an alliance this morning to thread a 84-run stand but a poor shot selection led to Dhananjaya's wicket and the Sri Lankan innings nosedived from thereon. Had Vishwa Fernando not scored 38 and added 25 runs for the final wicket, the lead conceded would have been even bigger.
Magnificent bowling performance by Zimbabwe! Sikandar Raza was the destroyer-in-chief for Sri Lanka as he hunted down 7 wickets and never allowed the visitors to get back on track.

OUT! The last wicket has come at last for Zimbabwe as they break the 67- ball stand which added 25 runs. Back of a length delivery outside off, Fernando stands back to force it through the line but  gets a fat outside edge behind. Chakabva dives across to his right and takes a terrific catch. Sri Lanka all out for 293!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks.
Vishwa has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish and outside off, Kumara drives it nicely through covers for three runs.
Afternoon session extended! Zimbabwe have taken the extra 30 minutes in the session to pick the last wicket.
Allows the ball to spin back in and punches it to covers.
An arm ball yorker on middle, Fernando falls over a bit as he digs it out to safety.
Floated ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Again an attempted leg spinner by Raza goes wrong. It's short and down the leg side, Vishwa tries to pull but misses.
Extra flight on this ball, the length is full and has been driven straight to covers.
Too full in length on off, Fernando presses forward and defends it to the off side.
Fuller ball on off, Kuamra pushes off the outside half of the bat towards point.
Length and around off, Kuamra  defends it off the back foot towards mid off.
Back of a length ball on off, Kumara blocks it towards covers.
Length ball on off, Kumara defends the ball right under his eyes off the front foot.
Back of a length ball on off, Kumara defends it towards covers off the back foot.
Length ball around off, Kumara defends it off the back foot towards covers.
Victor Nyauchi (21-6-37-0) is back for another spell. The last wicket stand is worth 22 runs and is frustrating the home team.
Turning into the batsman from a fuller length around middle, Fernando tries to defend but it takes the inner half and rolls wide of short leg.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Goes on the back foot to a short ball and forces it out to covers.
Fullish ball on off, Vishwa defends it off his front foot.
Flatter and shorter delivery outside off, Fernando rocks back to punch it through covers but it takes the outer half of his willow and runs down to third man for two.
Play and a miss! That's not too far away from the stumps. Tossed up ball landing outside off and spinning in a bit, Fernando swings his bat at it and misses.
Floated ball on off and middle, Kumara blocks it off the front foot to the off side.
Tossed up around off, Fernando pushes it through covers and scampers for a single.
Flighted ball on middle, Fernando pushes it off the back foot to the leg side.
Tossed up outside off, Fernando looks to defend it but the ball beats the outside edge and goes to the keeper.
FOUR! Pitched up ball on middle, Fernando lofts it over the bowler and the ball rolls behind to the fence.
Tossed up on off, Fernando comes on the front foot and dead-bats it.
Tossed up on middle, Kumara prods to defend but is beaten to get rapped high on the pads.
Tossed up on middle,  Kumara blocks it off the front foot.
Tossed up ball and on off, pushed to covers for a run.
This time gets it a bit fuller and on middle, Fernando defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up on leg, Fernando leaves it alone.
Coming from round the wicket. Raza tosses one up on middle and gets it to spin towards the batsman. Vishwa looks to defend it but the ball bounces a bit and beats the bat to hit the thigh pad.
Once again the length is quite full around off, Kumara is forward in defense.
Too full in length on middle, Kumara strides forward and jams it out.
Drags it short this time, outside off, Fernando punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Action replay of the previous delivery. Mutombodzi is settling into a good rhythm.
Beaten! This time the length is full and the line is around off, drawing the batsman forward but then it spins away to beat the outside edge.
A leg spinner outside off, Fernando sticks back and allows it through.
Another tossed up ball on off which has been dead-batted by Kumara.
Raza goes full and on off, Kumara defends it off the front foot to the off side.
Slightly shorter in length and on off, Kumara defends it off the back foot.
Floated on middle and off, Fernando come on the front foot and keeps the ball out.
Tossed up on off, Fernando prods forward and smothers the spin.
Short ball outside off, Fernando cuts it to point and takes a couple.
Another full ball on off, Kumara defends it off the front foot.
Full and spinning in, Kumara keeps the bat pad together and defends it.
Another leg spinner on off, Kumara presents the full face of the bat this time.
Leg spinner on middle, Kumara defends it off the front foot.
Short ball spinning on middle and leg, Kumara pulls it to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Fernando smashes one straight to the bowler who misfields. The ball rolls towards mid off and the batsmen take a run.
Loopy and full around off, Vishwa pushes it gently to the left of the cover fielder and retains strike.
Tossed up ball on off, Fernando defends it back off his front foot.
Stretches forward to a full ball and flicks it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Spinning down the leg side, Vishwa lets it be.
Short in length and outside off, punched from the back foot to covers.
Full ball once again in the area outside off, Kumara blocks it off the front foot towards covers.
Full on off, Kumara defends it off the back foot towards point.
Tossed up leg spinner, Fernando punches the ball off the back foot through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Full ball from Mutombodzi. Fernando lofts it straight over mid off and the ball rolls to the fence.
Full on off, Fernando pushes it back to the bowler off the front foot.
Tossed up ball spinning away outside off, Fernando drives it through covers. The fielder from extra cover looks to field it but fumbles there. A couple taken.

Direct hit would have been all over for Sri Lanka! A very full ball outside off, Fernando pushes it to covers and sets off for a run. His partner is hesitant initially but then rushes across. The fielder has his shy at the striker's end but misses. The replays show that had Chakabva collected the ball cleanly then also Lahiru would have been a goner. End of an eventful over!
Floated off spinner outside off, full and spinning in, Fernando defends it back.
Lahiru Kumara is the last batsman.

OUT! Raza runs in joy for the seventh time! What a bowler! Pressure was mounting and the lower order batsmen don't often have the patience or skills to deal with it. Embuldeniya jumps down the track to break the shackles but ends up throwing his wicket away. A flighted full ball on middle, Lasith dances down the track to play a lofted shot over the bowler but mistimes it in the air. Mudzinganyama (sub) moves across to his left from mid off and takes the catch safely. Sri Lanka trail by 138 runs.
Lunges to a full ball around off and defends it solidly.
Short in length and outside off, Embuldeniya goes back and mistimes his square cut on the off side.
Full and flighted on middle, defended back to the bowler.
Floated around off, Fernando punches the ball off the back foot towards point.
Tossed up outside off, straighter one too. Fernando blocks it off the back foot.
Short and on middle, Fernando pulls it towards mid-wicket and finds the fielder.
Leg spinner once again but outside off, Fernando leaves it alone.

Yorker outside off, Fernando looks to push it off the back foot but the ball sneaks past the inside of the bat and rolls past the off stump. The keeper too is unaware of where the ball has headed. The fielder from the slip runs behind towards fine leg and mops it up. The batsmen take a couple. Byes given.
Leg spinner outside off, spinning away, Fernando lets it be.
Rinotenda Mutombodzi is on now. 7-0-34-0 are his figures so far.
Unplayable! Beauty to end the over. Floated ball landing full on middle, Lasith leans forward to defend but it grips and turns away to beat the outside edge.
Quicker around off, short and skidding in, Embuldeniya is on the back foot in defense.
Presses forward to a full ball and plays it with the spin. Finds mid off.
Flatter and around off, defended from the back foot to the off side.
Fullish and on off, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Tossed up ball outside off, Lasith drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Serves it on a length around off, Vishwa defends it off his front foot.
On the pads, helped on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Vishwa has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fullish and outside off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Shortish and outside off, Fernando smashes it through point and fetches a boundary.

COMEDY OF ERRORS! Complete hara-kiri! Horrible miscommunication but luckily for Sri Lanka no harm done. Good length delivery around off, Vishwa taps it down towards cover-point and looks for a run. His partner also steps out but then both are ball-watching. They soon realize that they are standing in the middle of the pitch and have to make a move on. Meanwhile, a very poor throw comes, in the middle of the pitch which the keeper collects after running forward. Chakabva turns to have a shy at his end but misses and Vishwa survives. One of the slip fielders backs up the throw and also has a shy at the non-striker's end but the bowler fails to collect it cleanly. Embuldeniya reaches safely as well. So much drama for zero run and it's very poor cricket all around by both teams.
Fullish and on off, pushed off the front foot to short extra cover.
Quicker arm ball around middle, Lasith defends it from the crease to the off side.
Swing and a miss! Floated off spinner landing full outside off, Embuldeniya tries to slog sweep but fails to connect.
Lucky runs. Full and flighted outside off, Fernando outside edges his attempted drive to third man for three runs.
Flatter and on off, defended solidly from the crease.
Short in length and around off, spinning back in, Fernando goes deep inside the crease and somehow keeps it out from the inner half of his bat. Got cramped up completely.
Beaten! Tiripano puts it on a length and outside off, LE pushes inside the line and gets beaten due to the angle of the bowler.
Bouncer around off, Lasith ducks at the last moment.
Pitches it up and around off, Embuldeniya drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Closer to the off stump, on a length, Embuldeniya covers the line and dead-bats it.
Angling away from the batsman, on a length, Lasith has nothing to do with it.
Good length ball on off, angling away, Embuldeniya stays back and pushes it with an angled bat to cover-point.

EDGED! But short. Fernando is lucky there. Raza gives this one more air and lands it a bit fuller around off. Fernando pushes at it from within the crease. The ball goes straight on and takes the outside edge. It goes towards the first slip fielder where Taylor goes for the catch but the ball bounces just in front of him.
Raza bowls one fuller but the line is down the leg side. Fernando does not fiddle with it and lets it through.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, further pushing the batsman in the crease. Fernando does well to keep it out right under his eyes.
Tossed up on off, Fernando defends it off the back foot towards short leg.
Tossed up and on middle, Fernando punches it off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up and on off, Fernando pushes it to the off side off the front foot.

Drinks break. Powered by Sikandar Raza, Zimbabwe continue to march on in this Test match and the first hour after Lunch has been really fruitful for them. Three wickets so far and they have forced Sri Lanka into a corner. They are on their way to gain a handy lead but cannot afford to relax as these days removing the tail has become quite frustrating for the bowlers.
Hurls across a length ball outside off, Embuldeniya allows it through to complete the over.
A good-looking cover drive by Lasith but the short cover fielder dives to his left to stop the racing ball.
What a delivery! Tiripano serves full length ball around off and takes it away with the angle, Embuldeniya stays back to push inside the line and misses.
Sliding down the leg side, Fernando tickles it towards square leg for a run.

FOUR! The deficit drops down below 150! Back of a length delivery outside off, Fernando stays back to punch it through the line but it takes the outer edge and beats the diving gully fielder for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Fernando allows it through to the keeper.
Donald Tiripano (21-11-21-1) is back into the attack. It will be fitting for him to pick a few wickets. Has worked really hard in this innings and has been very miser.
Lovely delivery to beat the outside edge. Drifting into the batsman around off, Lasith prods forward to defend but it spins away to beat him completely.
Fine shot! Floated full ball around off, Embuldeniya charges down the track and lifts it over covers for a couple of runs.
Spinning back into the batsman from around off, Vishwa stands back to defend but misses. It deflects off his pads towards the right of first slip. They steal a leg bye.
Skidding down the leg side, Embuldeniya tucks it behind square leg and rotates the strike.
Very full in length on middle, it's driven back to the bowler.
Flighted ball close to off, on the shorter side and spinning away, Lasith moves back and pushes inside the line. It takes a soft outside edge and goes past first slip to short third man.
Another delivery which is bowled in the channel around off, Fernando does well to block it off the front foot.

Fuller in length and coming into the batsman. Fernando pushes it off the front foot this time. Mumba has been warned for running on the danger area. This is his second warning we are hearing, so one more such instance and he won't be able to bowl in this innings.
Third leave in a row. Length ball but way outside off, Fernando does not play at it.
On a good length and outside off, a little bit of movement, Fernando lets it go.
Length ball outside off, Fernando lets it be.
On a fuller length and around off, Fernando defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up ball on off, Embuldeniya defends it off the back foot.
That ball has a lot of spin on it. It is tossed up outside off, it spins away from the batsman but Lasith does well to block it.
Tossed up outside off, Lasith lets it be.
Tossed up on off, Lasith prods forward and dead-bats it.
Full once again on the pads, pushed back to the bowler.
Full ball angled into the pads, Lasith squeezes it towards mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Slips a length ball down the leg side, Vishwa allows it through to the keeper. End of a successful over for Mumba!
Bouncer on middle, Vishwa ducks at the last moment.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

EDGY FOUR! Sri Lanka won't mind how the runs come as long as they come. Fullish delivery outside off, shaping away a hint, Fernando leans forward to drive but it takes the outer half and races through the gap between slips and gully for a boundary.
Angles in a length ball on off, it's defended off the front foot by Vishwa.
Vishwa Fernando is the new batsman.

OUT! Body blow to Sri Lanka as the last recognized batsman is strangled down the leg side. Mumba hunts down the big fish, although with a harmless delivery. It's a touch short and drifting down the leg side, Mathews shuffles across to work it off his pads but gets a gentle inside edge behind. Chakabva grabs it with ease and they all run in appeal. The finger has gone up and a disappointed Mathews is on his way back. Sri Lanka trail by 162 runs.
Carl Mumba (16-3-39-1) is back on.
Tossed up around off, Lasith blocks to the off side.
Loopy ball, straighter on off, Mathews plays for the spin and ends up edging it behind. It goes wide of first slip and they collect a single.
Short and wide outside off, Mathews goes for the cut through point. But the ball bounces a bit there and it beats the batsman on the outside edge.
Tossed up and on middle, Mathews pushes the ball off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Floated ball but down the leg side, Mathews attempts to lay bat on ball but misses it. The keeper does the rest.
Tossed up and straighter on middle and off, Mathews prods forward and dead-bats it.
Lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Switches to 'round the wicket for the left-hander and slants in a full ball on off, Embuldeniya defends it to the off side.
Very full this time, outside off, Mathews drives it down to long off for a run.
Angles in a full ball on off, Angelo presses forward and defends it back.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Mathews rocks back to cut but fails to beat the diving gully fielder.
A length ball outside off, Angelo gets forward and pushes it to point.
Tossed up once again on off and Lasith defends it off the back foot.
OH! A ripper there. Lots of turn on it. It is pitched on off and then the ball spins away. Lasith looks to defend it only to gets beaten by the away spin.
Full and angled into the left-hander. Embuldeniya dead-bats it off the front foot.
Lasith Embuldeniya is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Lakmal goes now. Raza is making a mockery of the Sri Lankan batting. This is now his best Test effort. He tosses one around off and makes the ball  to spin in towards the batsman. Lakmal looks to play the flick through mid-wicket but the ball goes uppishly towards the man there and Mutombodzi accepts it gleefully. Mathews is running out of partners. Sri Lanka trail by 164 runs and are on the verge of conceding a big lead.
Floated ball on off, Mathews pushes it through cover-point and gets to the other end.
Tossed up outside off, coming in towards the batsman. Mathews defends it.
Full and outside off, Lakmal drives it straight to the man at mid off.
Length ball on off, pushed off the back foot towards the bowler.
Full on the pads, Lakmal looks to go for the flick but misses it. The ball rolls off the pads towards keeper who dives to his left and takes it.
Full ball on off, Lakmal drives it to covers where the fielder fields it.
Length ball in the channel outside off, Lakmal has a feel for it as the ball goes past the outside edge.
Length ball coming in towards off stump, Mathews defends it to mid-wicket off the back foot and takes a run.
Presses forward to a full ball and eases it with the spin to mid-wicket. It's to the right of the fielder and Angelo pinches a run to retain strike.
Shortish and spinning down the leg side, Lakmal moves back to pull but misses. The keeper also fails to collect and they cross for a bye.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
This time Lakmal properly covers the spin and defends it off his back foot.

Beauty of a delivery and it misses the off stump by a whisker. Lovely off break delivery, landing on a fuller length outside off and spinning back in sharply. Lakmal tries to drive it against the turn and gets beaten.
Allows the ball to spin back into the batsman and turns it in front of square leg for a single.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Fullish and around off, Lakmal goes hard at it and it takes the inside edge before rapping him on the pads.
Pitches it up and around off, it's flicked on the leg side but once again straight to short mid-wicket.
Uses the angle of the bowler and works it off his pads to short mid-wicket.

False shot! Nyauchi serves it full and wide outside off, Lakmal goes chasing and misses. He needs to be sensible with his shot selection with Mathews at the other end. His plan should be to just partner him.
Good length ball around off, Lakmal stays back and punches it to the off side.
Tossed up and spinning in, Mathews prods forward and defends it.
Full ball on off, Lakmal drives it through mid on and takes a single.
Another ball which is on leg stump, easy pickings for Lakmal as he tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a couple.
Once again floated on leg, Lakmal tucks it along with the spin past square leg. The fielder there gives the chase and stops the ball. A couple taken.
Flighted ball on middle and leg, Lakmal tucks it with the spin towards square leg.
Tossed up ball outside off, Mathews drives the ball through covers. The fielder there gives the chase and just about manages to field the ball inside the rope. The batsmen though get three.
Length ball on off, blocked off the front foot.
Beaten! Length and outside off, Lakmal looks to defend it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length ball outside off, Lakmal looks to defend it but gets an edge that rolls towards the keeper.
Full length ball outside off, Mathews drives it towards mid off and takes a run.
Length and on off, Mathews defends it to the off side.
Outside off, left alone.
Full on off, blocked off the back foot towards the off side. Successful over for Zimbabwe!
Once again tosses one up outside off, Lakmal is happy to defend it.
Full ball outside off, Lakmal pushes it to point.
Tossed up outside off, the ball spins in once again and Lakmal offers no shot to it. The ball hits the thigh pad.
Suranga Lakmal walks in to bat next.

OUT! LBW! Sikandar Raza has a 5-fer, his second in Tests. He tosses one up on off and gets it to come in with the angle. Dickwella goes for the sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. The bowler appeals there and the umpire gives it out. Easy call there for the umpire as Niroshan was pinged right in front of the stumps. What an asset Sikandar is for his team!
Tossed up on off, Dickwella goes on the back foot and plays the ball with the spin towards the leg side.
Sikandar Raza to bowl from the other end.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
BEATEN! Victor bowls one outside off and on a length, Mathews prods forward to defend but it nips away to beat the outside edge.
Length ball angled away outside off, Dickwella slaps it towards covers and gets to the other end.
Fuller in length and outside off, Mathews drives it through covers. The batsmen get a single only as Raza is quick to field the ball.
Length ball outside off, swinging away too. Mathews leaves it alone.
Full ball outside off, Mathews drives it straight to mid off.

Welcome back for the afternoon session. The Sri Lankans will be relieved that their crisis man Angelo Mathews is still out there fighting. He is accompanied by Niroshan Dickwella as the last recognized batsman in this Sri Lankan line-up. The visitors will hope that these two continue and help the side to first wipe of the deficit. On the other hand, Zimbabwe will want to take the remaining 5 wickets quickly and take a handy lead in the game. Victor Nyauchi to start the proceedings for the home team after the break.
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

The Islanders had their backs to the wall in the first hour after a couple of blows but the pair of Angelo Mathews and Dhananjaya de Silva revived their innings with an 84-run stand. The duo batted with relative ease and notably targeted Sikandar Raza. Just at the stroke of Lunch, Dhananjaya ran out of patience and gifted his wicket away, thereby once again putting Sri Lanka on the back foot. The deficit for them is still 180 runs and the onus falls on Angelo Mathews and the lower order to bail them out. Do join us at 1240 local (1040 GMT) for the second session.

Zimbabwe's session mainly due to the wicket falling in the last over! Otherwise, it was a session of two halves! One enjoyed by Zimbabwe another by Sri Lanka. Zimbabwe started Day 3 on a positive note and consumed the wicket of Kusal Mendis early. Although that wicket cost them Kevin Kasuza who suffered a concussion after getting hit on the helmet while fielding at short leg. Soon after that Sikandar Raza sent Dinesh Chandimal packing and put Sri Lanka in a spot of bother.
Loopy full ball around off, Niroshan defends it from the inner half of his bat. LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Fullish and on middle, swept straight to short fine leg.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Niroshan Dickwella walks in next to partner Mathews.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The golden-arm of Raza strikes again. A flatter short delivery around off, turning back in and staying a touch low as well, de Silva goes back to pull but is in no position to unveil that shot. He misses it completely and finds his off stump uprooted. Dhananjaya departs with a forlorn face and two more members of the Lankan team will be disappointed - Mathews, as his advice was not taken and Grant Flower, the batting coach. Unnecessary shot selection. The 84-run stand has been broken at the stroke of Lunch and Sri Lanka trail by 180 runs.

Swing and a miss! Flighted delivery outside off, turning back in, de Silva tries for the slog sweep again and misses. Mathews has a quiet word with him, maybe reminding him that Lunch is around the corner.

Collision in the deep! Flighted full ball on middle, de Silva goes down and slog sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. Two fielders converge and try to make a sliding stop near the fence and collide in the process. No harm done and the batsmen collect a couple of runs.
Sikandar Raza (26-4-83-3) is brought back into the attack at the stroke of Lunch.
Full ball on off once again and Mathews plays it off the back foot towards covers.
Full ball on off, Mathews plays is with a straight bat past the bowler but the fielder from mid on cuts it off by running to his left.
Full and angled on off, Mathews plays it off the front foot and towards the off side.
On a good length and outside off, Mathews is happy to leave it.
Length and outside off, going further away, Mathews lets it be.

FOUR! A rare bad ball from Tiripano. He bowls one on a length and way outside off, Mathews frees his arms and punches the ball through cover-point. The ball races to the fence in no time. That also brings up the fifty for Mathews, his 35th in Tests. He needs to continue though. Has been patiently playing the balls and leaving them. Got tested with short stuff too but has kept his cool and continues to play the ball on its merit.
FOUR! Full ball outside off, de Silva squeezes it out past gully and the ball races to the fence for a boundary. There is no third man in place to cut that off.
Full ball once again on the pads, de Silva flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full and on the pads, Mathews flicks it toward fine leg for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Mathews hops and plays it towards the off side.
Good length and around off, Mathews drives it straight to the man at mid off.
Full ball on off, Mathews drives it straight back past the bowler and the mid on fielder cleans it up. Excellent shot for nothing.
Length and around off, de Silva plays the perfect cover drive only for the fielder to field it.
FOUR! Too straight from Tiripano there. He bowls one on the pads and de Silva tucks it fine towards fine leg and the ball goes for a boundary. A rare bad ball by Donald!
Full and outside off, de Silva lets it be.
Back of a length ball on off, de Silva punches it off the back foot to the off side.
Length ball on middle, Mathews drives one through mid on and takes a run.
Full and outside off, no swing on that, Mathews defends it off the front foot.

Appeal for LBW! The umpire is not interested. Mumba bowls on a length and de Silva looks to flick it but he fails in the attempt and is rapped on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Maybe, height was an issue there.
Full and on middle, de Silva flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle, de Silva drives it to find mid on.
Yorker on middle, de Silva does well to dig it out towards the leg side.
Length ball going way outside off, de Silva lets it be.
Full and targeting the pads, Mathews flicks it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Mathews hops and tucks it towards fine leg to retain the strike.
Full and outside off, kept out to the off side.

Now bowls one on a length and outside off, shaping away a bit. Mathews goes for the drive only to get a thick outside edge through gully. The fielder from point gives the chase and keeps the batsmen down to two. Sri Lanka have avoided the follow-on!
Nip-backer outside off, Mathews looks to play away from his body and leaves a big gap between bat and pad. The ball sneaks through it and goes to the left of the keeper.
Length ball angled onto the pads, Mathews flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full and straight on off, driven towards mid on.
Donald Tiripano to share the second new ball. 18-11-9-1 are his figures, so far.

FOUR! Fine shot! Good use of the wrists by Dhananjaya! Mumba is very full with his length around off, de Silva leans forward and across before flicking it through the gap between mid on and mid-wicket for a boundary.
Yorker on off, de Silva digs it out to point.
Mumba gets fuller and around off, Dhananjaya plays a delightful cover drive but finds the fielder. Good shot for nothing!
This one is served on a good length and outside off, an easy leave for the batsman.
Fuller length ball on off, shaping back in a bit, de Silva brings down a straight bat in defense.
A very full delivery outside off, Dhananjaya squeezes it out through covers and scampers back for the second run.
SECOND NEW BALL IS TAKEN! Carl Mumba (13-3-27-0) to make the first use of it.
Fuller on middle and leg, de Silva drives it towards mid on and retains the strike. 200 up for Sri Lanka.
Leg spinner on off, de Silva is happy to block it off the back foot.
Tossed up ball on off, it goes straighter this time, Mathews drives it towards mid off and hares for a run.
Tossed up around middle and leg, spinning in, de Silva flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Beauty of a nut. Mutombodzi bowls a tossed up ball on off, it spins past the forward prod of the batsman and beats him on the outside edge.
Full and straighter on off, de Silva defends it off the back foot.
Full ball on the pads, Mathews tucks it to the leg side.
Full on the pads, driven to mid on.
Full and down the leg side, Mathews tucks it to square leg.
Full and angled on the pads, Mathews flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, de Silva tucks it towards mid-wicket and goes to the other end.
Tossed up ball outside off, de Silva cuts it through point and takes a couple.
Short and wide outside off, cut straight to point. Another dismal over by the debutant leggie.
A full toss on middle, knocked down to wide long on for a brace. 50-run stand comes up between the two!
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it back to the bowler.
Flatter and shorter outside off, punched to sweeper cover for one.
Outside off, Mathews flashes and misses.
Tinotenda Mutombodzi to roll his arm over. 5-0-27-0 are his figures so far.
Fuller and on middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket.
Off spinner on middle and leg, de Silva tucks it to the leg side.
Tossed up and straighter on off, de Silva plays the forward defense.
Once again full ball on the pads and de Silva tucks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, spinning in too. de Silva tucks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Raza goes short and wide outside off, de Silva rocks back on the back foot and cuts it through point and the ball meets the fence there.
FOUR! Mathews has found the boundary. Full ball on off, no movement on it. Mathews drives it straight past the bowler and the ball rolls towards the long off fence for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on off, Mathews hops inside the crease and pushes it to covers.
Length ball but way outside off, Mathews lets it be.
Outswinger but outside off, Mathews does not fiddle with it.
Full and straight outside off, Mathews drives it to mid off.
Length and outside off, going away from the batsman too, Mathews drives it to covers.
Allows the ball to spin back into him and drives a full ball to long on for a run.

Mathews is hurried up! Raza gets a full ball to spin back into the right-hander from outside off, Angelo tries flicking but gets an inside edge onto the pads. A stifled appeal for an lbw dies down quickly.
Turning back into the batsman, Mathews flicks it a bit uppishly but wide of short leg.
Fires in a quicker one on middle, shorter in length, Angelo goes deep inside the crease and blocks it safely.
Square leg drops back.

SIX! Another delivery by Raza travels the distance. Full and floated around off, Mathews goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it with the spin. Finds good connection and dumps the ball over square leg for a maximum.
Flatter and shorter on middle, defended off the back foot to the leg side.
Outside off, left alone to complete the over. A maiden!
Misfield by the substitute this time but no run taken. Fullish delivery outside off, Dhananjaya drives it to covers where Maruma fumbles but recovers in time.
Around off on a good length, de Silva defends it from the back foot.

Fine stop at covers! Full in length and outside off, Dhananjaya likes to feel bat on ball and reaches out for it. Plays a cover drive but fails to beat the diving effort by the substitute fielder (Maruma).
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, shaping back in a bit, de Silva covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Fullish and close to off, Dhananjaya drives but finds the fielder at covers.
Another off spinner on off and middle, Mathews pushes it off the front foot towards the off side.
Off spinner on middle, Mathews blocks it off the front foot.
Another tossed up ball but way down the leg side. Mathews looks to tuck it to the leg side but fails to get any wood on the ball.
Loopy ball coming in with the angle, Mathews works it toward square leg.
Floated ball on off, spinning into the batsman once again, de Silva drives it towards mid on and gets off the strike.
Tossed up ball coming in with the angle, de Silva pushes it back to the bowler.
Length ball but down the leg side. Mathews goes for the flick but misses it. The keeper does well to field it by going to his left.
Full and on off, Mathews   blocks it off the front foot.

FOUR! Superbly driven. Fuller in length and outside off, Mathews just leans  and drives it in the gap at cover-point. The fielders from both cover and point go for the chase but both fail as the ball beats their efforts and roll over the fence.
Full and swinging in on off, Mathews moves inside the crease and blocks it off the front foot.
Full ball outside off, Mathews drives it straight to point.
Length ball swinging in towards the batsman, Mathews flicks it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket who dives to his right and fields it.
Raza shortens his length and serves it on middle, de Silva moves back to work it on the leg side but misses and is hit on the thigh pad. 10 from the over!
Uses his feet this time to a full ball and pushes it to covers.

FOUR! The variation goes all wrong for Raza. He attempts for a leg spinner but ends up serving it short and on middle, Dhananjaya uses the depth of his crease and pulls it behind square leg for a boundary.
Loopy full ball around off, slow turn back into the batter, Dhananjaya defends it back off his front foot.
Raza slows it up around off and gets it to spin back into the batsman from a fuller length, de Silva presses forward and works it to mid-wicket.
SIX! Sri Lanka have decided to take on Sikandar Raza. Good use of the feet by de Silva. An off spinner landing full around off, Dhananjaya wears his skates and hoists it over long on.
Length ball which goes straight outside off, Mathews leaves it yet again.
Outswinger outside off, Mathews leaves it for the keeper.
Length ball outside off, swinging away, Mathews pushes it to covers.

Length ball on the pads, de Silva flicks it through mid-wicket. The fielder from mid-wicket gives the chase. The ball slows down before the rope due to the lack of timing on the shot. The fielder fields it and saves a run for his team. Three taken in the end.
Another back of a length ball on off, de Silva stays on the back foot and blocks the ball down safely.
Back of a length ball on off, de Silva punches it off the back foot towards mid off.

The ball is lost after the biggie and the umpires are getting the replacement. With this the players take the Drinks break too. A fine phase of play this morning for Zimbabwe. They have come out with better intent and snapped two vital wickets by giving away just 35 runs. Sri Lanka will be feeling the pressure but as long as they have Angelo Mathews in the middle, they will be hopeful of a revival. Victor Nyauchi to continue after the break.
SIX! Superbly timed shot. Mathews sees the length early. It's very full and around middle, Mathews kneels and slogs it handsomely over backward square leg for a biggie. This shot came out of nowhere.
Short ball on off, Mathews blocks it off the back foot towards the leg side.
Full ball on off, de Silva drives it towards mid on and gets to the other end.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Mathews flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball on off and middle, defended of the front foot towards the off side.
Tossed up ball on off, de Silva drives it toward mid on for a run.
Driven towards the mid off region.
Full ball on off, Mathews drives it through point for a couple.
Full ball on off, Mathews drives it towards covers.
Length ball on off, blocked off the front foot.
Full ball on off, Mathews drives it through point and gets a couple.
Length ball around off, Mathews drives it off the front foot towards mid off.
Victor Nyauchi is on now. 11-4-17-0 are his figures so far.
Shorter on middle, de Silva punches the ball off the back foot.
Loopy ball on off, de Silva pushes the ball towards mid on.
Full ball on middle and leg, de Silva flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short and on middle, de Silva punches it off the back foot to the leg side.
Full ball on off, Mathews pushes the ball through covers and calls for a quick single.
Tossed up ball on off, Mathews pushes it to covers off the front foot.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and tries to defend. But it takes the bottom edge of his bat and rolls behind to the keeper.
Lands it on a length and outside off, holding its line, Dhananjaya withdraws his bat at the last moment.
Good length delivery around off, de Silva goes on the back foot and blocks it to the leg side.
Closer to the off stump, full in length, Dhananjaya defends it back off his front foot.
Pitches it up and just outside off, de Silva takes his front leg forward and allows it through to the keeper.
Short in length around off, Mathews does well to keep his pull shot down and places it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Full ball on middle and off, de Silva pushes it off the back foot to the leg side.
Dhananjaya de Silva is the new batsman.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Raza is on fire. He has a 3-fer to his name now. Superb bowling this from Sikandar. He tossed one up and gets the ball to spin back into the batsman. Chandimal remains on the back foot to punch it through the line but is cramped for room. In the end, he chips the ball to the left of the bowler who gobbles it up without any fuss. Sri Lanka in some trouble now!
Chandimal shimmies down the track once again and smothers the spin on this tossed up ball.
SIX! Tossed up on middle and leg, Chandimal dances down the track and lofts this one over the mid-wicket fence. The ball goes a long way back into the stands.
Chandimal dances down the track to block this loopy ball on off.
Full and angled into the pads, Mathews flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and on off, driven towards covers off the front foot.
Chandimal blocks this length ball off the back foot towards the bowler.
Back of a length ball on off, Chandimal pushes the ball off the back foot towards the off side.
Chandimal drives this length ball straight to the man at covers.
Length ball on off, Mathews drives it towards mid off and takes off for a run. The fielder at mid off has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Mathews drives this full ball on middle towards mid on.
Almost a yorker on middle, Chandimal works it past short leg. End of a successful over for the hosts.
Dinesh Chandimal has joined Mathews in the middle with Sri Lanka trailing by 272 runs.

Stretcher comes out as Kevin Kasuza is down in pain. He has not moved much and there are some concerned faces all around. Match referee, Javagal Srinath, is standing near the Zimbabwean dressing room and is having a chat with the medical team. Kasuza is getting stretchered off the field! We wish him a speedy recovery. Getting to hear that he is going for a scan straightaway. Poor guy was concussed in the first Test as well and coincidentally that time too Kusal Mendis' shot hit him at short leg.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mendis departs. But it seems there is a big injury on the field. Kevin Kasuza is down in pain and has not moved at all. Coming to the delivery, it's short and on middle, Mendis goes deep inside the crease and plays a full-blooded pull shot. He hits it right from the middle of the bat and Kevin Kasuza at short leg ducks to evade. But it hits him flush on the helmet and balloons to backward square leg. Mumba stationed there takes the catch easily and Mendis has to walk back. He was dropped twice on Day 2, on 1 and 13, but he fails to punish Zimbabwe.
Full and angling onto the pads, Mendis drives it straight to mid on.
Fuller one from Raza on middle, Mendis prods forward and keeps the ball out.
Floated delivery on middle and leg, Mathews works towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Short ball on middle and leg, Mendis rocks back and pulls it to deep square leg. A run taken.
Sikandar Raza (17-4-39-1) to roll his arm over.
Another confident drive off the front foot by Angelo but he fails to find the gap. It goes straight to covers and that ends a maiden over by Donald.
Fullish and on off, Mathews drives it off his front foot but finds mid off.

That's a beautiful delivery and a brave leave by Mathews. Tiripano dishes out an inswinger just outside off and gets it to curl back in off the seam. Mathews takes his front leg forward to cover the sticks and then allows it through. To his good luck, the ball beats the off stump by a whisker.
Back of a length delivery in the channel outside off, Angelo pushes it out to short extra cover with a tentative footwork.
Tiripano goes closer to the stumps on this occasion. It's full and angling in towards off, Mathews strides forward and defends it back.
Good length delivery in the region outside off, Mathews has nothing to do with it.
Mendis defends the length ball towards point.

FOUR BYES! Mumba had been taking everything away from the right-hander but this time he bowls a delivery jagging back into the batsman. Mendis there leaves it. The ball goes past the off pole and further away from the keeper who dives to his left. The ball in the end rolls to the fine leg fence. Byes given by the umpire.
Full in length and Mendis blocks it off the front foot.
Another ball which is outside off, Mendis is not lured to play at it.
A quick single. Mathews  taps this length ball towards mid-wicket and takes off for a run. Raza there has a shy at the bowler's end but he misses.
Slightly fuller in length and outside off, Mathews watches it patiently as he shoulders arms to it.
Length ball on off, Mendis defends it off the back foot towards the off side.
Mendis chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
On a good length and outside off, Mendis lifts his bat and watches the ball go towards the keeper.
Length ball outside off by Tiripano. Mendis shoulders arms to it.
Another full length ball on off, Mendis defends it off the front foot.
Fuller in length and on off, Mendis keeps it out off the front foot.
Full on middle, driven towards mid on.
Back of a length ball outside off, Mathews cuts it to find cover-point.
Short ball outside off, Mathews looks to cut it uppishly through point but he fails to get anything behind the ball.
On a length and outside off, Mathews leaves it confidently.
Good length and closer to the off stump. Mathews covers his sticks and leaves it.
Length ball shaping away outside off, Mathews shoulders arms to it.
In the region outside off, on a length and nipping away, Mendis shoulders arms.
Forces a length ball in the gap at covers for a single.
Full ball on middle, pushed towards mid on.
Length delivery outside off, left alone by Mathews.
On a fuller length on off, driven to short cover.
Length ball on off, pushed to covers.
Outside off, Mendis lets it be. A watchful start by Sri Lanka!
Outside off off, kept out safely to the off side.
On a fuller length and on off, Mendis drives it through cover-point and scampers back for a comfortable two.
Length ball on the pads, Mathews flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Mumba overpitches on off, Mathews drives it straight to covers.
Good length ball outside off, Mathews is not bothered to play it.
Length ball on off, pushed to mid off off the front foot.
Mendis plays the forward push to this length ball outside off. The ball rolls towards point.
Full on middle, driven towards mid on for a single.
Mathews shoulders arms to another length ball outside off.
Good length ball on off, Mathews lets the ball through to the keeper.
On a good length and shaping away outside off, Mathews lets it be.
Mendis leaves the length ball outside his off stump to see off the over.
Outside off, left alone.
Full ball on middle, Kusal drives it straight to mid on.
Short ball on middle, Mendis pulls only to find mid on.
Length and on off, Mendis punches it to the off side off the back foot.
Starts with a length ball outside off, Mendis is happy to let that go.
Time to get underway! The players are out in the centre. Angelo Mathews and Kusal Mendis to resume their innings. Carl Mumba to kickoff proceedings for the home team. Here we go...

We're up early for this contest to make up for the lost overs last evening. On the weather front, the forecast is for 80 percent chance of rain but for now, there appears to be no immediate threat. On that good note, allow us to welcome you for the third day of this Test match in Harare. The hosts still hold the aces after posting 406 on Day 2 but as we witnessed in the first Test match, Sri Lanka slowly but steadily ate out the deficit. Zimbabwe would be aware of that and would have planned diligently. For Sri Lanka, two of their most experienced batsmen are in the middle and they would be hopeful of a big stand. Everything is set up beautifully and let's wait and watch how this moving day takes off...
... DAY 3, SESSION 1 ...

Right then, it's time to bid you farewell. We will be having an early start on Day 3 and the action will resume here at 0930 local (0730 GMT). If we get an uninterrupted play on Wednesday, Day 4 will start 7 minutes early. The rain has been good with us so far in this Test match and let's hope for the same to continue. Cheers!

Earlier in the day, Zimbabwe's tail wagged a bit to push their total beyond the 400-run mark. Post that, the Sri Lankan batsmen batted with authority in the afternoon session and kept the Zimbabwean bowlers at bay. Both Dimuth Karunaratne and Oshada Fernando were solid during their stay but the picture changed after Tea. The hosts came out with better planning and execution to dismiss the Lankan openers in quick succession and had they not dropped Kusal Mendis twice, their position in this Test match would have been even better. They currently have a 284-run lead but need to spend it smartly on Day 3.
With the light not improving, the umpires have called for STUMPS ON DAY 2! A couple of days of attritional cricket we have witnessed and this Test match is hanging right in the balance.

Update 1653 local (1453 GMT) - Not looking good at all. The umpires have called for covers now. It's not raining yet and it seems like a precautionary measure. The wind has picked up as well. We're waiting for the official confirmation as the umpires are leaving the field. It has started to drizzle now.

Update 1647 local (1447 GMT) - The two umpires are back on the field, inspecting the conditions. The light appears to have improved slightly but not sure it's good enough to call the players back on the field. They will have to keep the safety of players in mind. Stay tuned for latest updates...

BAD LIGHT STOPS PLAY! Angelo Mathews is not happy with the fading light, looks at the umpires and this time the officials are convinced. The players are heading off the field. Umpire Aleem Dar takes the reading of the light and this will be the benchmark for the entire Test match. Let's hope we get some more over in the day's play. Stay tuned...
A touch flat and around off, Mathews pushes his weight on the back leg and defends it watchfully.
Very full again from the leggie, not allowing the ball to do its bit, Mathews jams it out back to the bowler.
Floated ball landing full around off, Angelo is forward in defense.
Too full in length on off, Mendis drives it square of the wicket on the off side and collects a run.
Leans forward to a full ball and pushes it gently to covers. Mendis is visibly not happy with the light.
Tossed up ball outside off, Mendis defends it off his front too to point.

Umpire Aleem Dar is taking the reading of the fading light. He feels that it's good enough at the moment to carry on with the play. Zimbabwe have made a bowling change. Tinotenda Mutombodzi (4-0-26-0) is back on.
Mathews plays a maiden there. He just prods forward and smothers the spin on this loopy ball on off.
Mathews tucks the full ball off his pads towards mid-wicket.
Mathews goes deep inside the crease and pushes this tossed up ball off the back foot.
Mathews tucks the loopy delivery off the back foot towards the leg side.
Lucky. Tossed up ball on off and middle. Mathews prods forward and goes for a defensive push but in the process gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball falls short of the short leg fielder there.
Full and on off, Mathews pushes it off the front foot.

The reserve umpire rushes out to the middle and hands over the light meter to umpire Aleem Dar. It's quite gloomy out there. The two umpires get together and then have a chat with Sikandar Raza and Brendan Taylor. Maybe, it's a hint that it's too dark to continue with a seamer. Raza though will continue from this end...
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it with an angled bat to cover-point.
Good length ball outside off, left alone by Kusal.
Pitches it up and outside off, it's stroked off the front foot to mid off.
Fullish and on middle, Mendis drives it down the ground but straight to mid on.
Outside off, left alone.
Streaky! Short in length and outside off, Mendis rocks back to slap it through point but it takes the outer half and runs to third man for two.

Appeal for LBW! The umpire is unmoved. Raza bowls a shorter one on middle and leg, skidding further down, Mendis goes for the pull but he misses it. The ball takes the pads and rolls through the legs of the keeper. Chakabva and the bowler appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Maybe, missing leg and also impact was outside leg. One added to the total as a leg bye.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Mathews punches it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Flighted on middle and spinning in, Mathews tucks it to the leg side.
Full and angling into the pads, Mathews flicks it to mid-wicket.
The players, as expected, are back on the field. Sikandar Raza to continue with his over.

Update 1610 local (1410 GMT) - DRIZZLING! The groundsmen are in action. They are running in with the covers. Hang on, they have stopped as it has also stopped drizzling. They are going away. The umpires have stayed out and will soon call out the players. Good signs. The official close of play has been extended by 5 minutes.
Mathews defends the tossed up ball on off, off the front foot.
Full and on the pads, Mathews tucks it to mid-wicket.
Mendis covers his off pole and lets the ball outside his off stump go to the keeper.

Superbly driven but Mendis will not get a boundary. Victor bowls full and outside off, Mendis drives it through covers. The fielder from point and cover give the chase. Raza from point fields it. A couple is what the batsmen get.
Mathews flicks the length ball off his pads through mid-wicket. The batsmen take a run.
Full ball on off, Mathews pushes it straight past the bowler. But rather unconvincingly.
Mathews keeps this length ball outside off towards the off side.
On a length on off, Mathews blocks it off the back foot.

DRINKS! A good hour for the home team as they have managed to see the back of both the Lankan openers. They bowled well in the afternoon as well but didn't get the reward. So far, it's been excellent going but they need to tighten the screws in the field. They have already dropped Kusal Mendis twice and a batsman of his caliber can really hurt them badly. 13 overs left in the day. Hopefully we will get all of them bowled and there won't be any rain interruptions. We are saying that because all of a sudden dark clouds are approaching the stadium.
Mendis tucks this full ball off his pads towards mid-wicket.
Loopy and on middle, pushed straight down the ground off the back foot. The batsmen cross ends.
Mathews pushes the tossed up ball off the front foot and to the leg side.
Mathews is content in playing the waiting game here. He pushes this loopy ball off the front foot.
Flighted around off, Mathews pushes the ball to covers.
Tossed up outside off, Mathews goes low as he defends it. The ball didn't bounce this time.
Nyauchi gets in the line of the stumps this time, it's blocked by Mendis.
Make it one more leave to a delivery outside off.
Movement away from the batsman, it's outside off and yet another easy leave for Kusal.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
On a length and outside off, shaping in, Mendis defends it to point.
A length ball around off, it's defended from the back foot.
Tossed up around off, kept out off the back foot.

DROPPED! Mendis is given a life once more. Tiripano is the culprit now. Raza tosses on up on off and Mendis goes for the slog sweep. He does not bother to keep it down and the ball goes in the air towards Tiripano in the deep mid-wicket region. He runs forward and goes for the catch but spills it. A run is what the batsmen get.
Tossed up ball on middle, tucked to square leg.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended off the back foot.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Mendis blocks it off the front foot.
Full and targeting the stumps, Mendis pushes it back by going deep inside the crease.
Length delivery outside off, not in the zone for Mathews to play. He lets it be.
Outside off, Mathews is not lured into it as he sees the ball go to the keeper.
Length ball on off, Mathews defends it off the back foot towards the leg side.
Length and outside off, Mathews is in now hurry to play at it.
Outside off, Mathews covers the sticks and lets it go.
Full ball outside off, Mathews plays a free-flowing drive but straight to the man at covers.
Victor Nyauchi (7-2-12-0) returns into the attack, replacing Donald Tiripano.
Full ball on off, Mendis blocks it off the front foot.
Another ball that is on the pads, Mathews works it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Flighted on off, Mathews is forward in defense to keep it out.
Tossed up and spinning in to the batsman. Mendis tucks it in front of square leg for a single.
SIX! Short and in the zone for Mendis to hit it. He just obliges by pulling it up and over the deep square leg fence for the first maximum of the innings.
Floated and outside off, Mendis defends it right under his eyes.
A touch short in length and outside off, Mathews pushes it out safely to covers. A wicket maiden for Donald Tiripano.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Edgy! A length ball outside off, Mathews pushes inside the line with gentle hands and it goes off the outside edge towards second slip. Doesn't carry.
Fullish and on off, Angelo gets behind the line and blocks it to the off side.
Greets the new batsman with a good length delivery just outside off, Mathews covers his stumps and shoulders arms.
Angelo Mathews arrives in the middle at number 4. He is fresh from his maiden double ton in Test cricket and would like to get another big one here.

OUT! Tiripano strikes! His perseverance pays off. Continues to probe with a fuller length delivery around off, Fernando is lured into the drive on this occasion and gets a healthy outside edge behind. Chakabva makes no mistake and both the Lankan openers are now back in the hut. Donald is up and running in celebration. It's been an amazing evening session for Zimbabwe so far. Sri Lanka trail by 302 runs.
Flighted ball on middle, Mendis is happy to block it out and see off the over.
Similar delivery. This time he gets it past the short leg fielder and towards mid-wicket for a single.
Once again Fernando flicks this floated ball on middle and leg to mid-wicket. Only to find the fielder there.
Loopy ball on middle, Fernando tucks it to the leg side.
Down the leg side, Fernando leaves it only to get it off the pads towards short fine leg.
Full ball outside off, Fernando goes for the reverse sweep but fails to middle it and the ball rolls towards the lone slip fielder.
Mendis drives this full ball to covers but finds the fielder.
Outside off, Mendis lets it be.
Mendis plays with an open face of the bat towards point.

Peach! Tiripano has been asking questions to the Lankan batsmen. He bowls in that channel outside off and forces the batsman to play at it. Mendis looks to defend it but is beaten on the outside edge.
Outside off, left alone.
Good length ball outside off, Mendis blocks it.
Floated down the leg side, Fernando goes for the flick but misses it.
Mendis this time drives a tossed up delivery on middle and leg to long on and gets off the strike.
Loopy on off, Mendis just blocks it by coming on the front foot.

FOUR! Brilliantly played. Full ball on off, Mendis dances down the track and lofts it over the mid on fielder for a boundary. That's one way to tackle a spinner, use your footwork and disturb their landing.
Tosses it up outside off, Mendis comes forward and smothers the spin on it.
Full on middle and leg, Mendis works it to the leg side with soft hands.
Length ball on middle and leg, Fernando flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Short of length ball outside off, Oshada cuts it to point.
Full and angling into the batsman, Fernando drives it but without any timing towards mid off.
Good length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Bottom edge! Back of a length ball outside off, Oshada cuts but finds the second slip fielder this time as the ball goes on the bounce to him.
Length ball angled in the off pole, Fernando drives it to the left of mid on.

DROPPED! Lifeline for Kusal Mendis. Raza gets his flatter off spinner to spin back in from the middle stump line, Mendis prods forward in defense but it spins in to take the inside edge. Masvaure stationed at short leg gets both hands on it but it slips out eventually. Need to take these at this level.
Turns it off his pads to the leg side but finds the fielder.
Very full and on middle, it's knocked down to long on for a run.
This time it has been pulled in the gap on the leg side and a single has been taken.
A long hop on middle, it's pulled across the line but straight to square leg.
Walks down the track and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Around middle and leg, angling down, Oshada fails to flick and is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal for an lbw follows but it's a mere inquiry. Missing leg easily. They cross for a leg bye.
Solidly defended. Fullish and around off, angling in, Fernando presses forward and presents a straight willow in defense.
Lands it on a length and just outside off, Oshada punches it from the back foot to the off side.
Serves a length ball close to off, Fernando defends it with an angled bat to the off side.
An extra fielder comes in the slip cordon. Two slips and a gully present now.
Pitches it up and outside off, shaping away, Oshada shoulders arms.
A length delivery in the channel around off, Fernando defends it from the crease to the off side.
Floater on off and middle, Mendis is forward in defense.
Once again tossed up on off, and spinning in, Mendis flicks it off the front foot straight to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, Mendis stays on the back foot and flicks the ball to mid-wicket.
Flighted down the leg side, Mendis looks to get some wood on the ball but he fails to do so. The keeper does the rest.
Kusal Mendis is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Celebration for the Zimbabweans. They have managed to get the breakthrough. Raza is the man who has done it. The off spinner goes very full and keeps it on middle, Karunaratne lines up for the sweep but the ball beats his bat and raps him on the front pad. Sikandar Raza goes up in a big appeal and the umpire gives it out. Replays show that Raza was fine with his landing and the ball might have been crashing into middle stump. The 94-run stand has been broken and the hosts would like to create more inroads from hereon.
Loopy ball outside off, Karunaratne taps it towards point.
On middle and leg, sliding down, Dimuth fails to flick and it goes off his pads to square leg. A leg bye is taken.
Short in length outside off, cut past point for one.
Gets behind the line of a full ball and drives it back to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, defended off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle, helped to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, punched off the back foot this time to cover-point.

Now a short ball outside off, Karunaratne cuts it past point. The fielder there, Kasuza, runs behind the ball and does a good job of fielding the ball well inside the rope. A couple is what the batsmen have to be content with.
Short ball on middle and leg, spinning in too. Dimuth pulls it through square leg and gets a couple.
Tossed up ball around off, punched off the back foot this time.
Flighted and around off, Dimuth skips down the track and defends it off the front foot.
Dimuth blocks this tossed up ball on off by showing the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Slightly back of a length ball on off, punched off the back foot.
Outside off, left alone.
Way wide outside off, Oshada looks to cut it but fails to reach the ball. It goes past the outside edge.
Length delivery outside off, Fernando is solid in defense.
BEATEN! Straightaway an appeal. Tiripano lands one on a length and around off, Oshada looks to defend it but the ball sneaks past the outside edge.

Welcome back for the final session of Day 2. Sri Lanka are cruising along nicely with their skipper out in the middle along with Oshada Fernando. Zimbabwe would look to make some inroads in this session and get a foothold in this match. Donald Tiripano to kickoff this session. 29 overs left in the day's play.
... DAY 2, SESSION 3 ...

82/0 in the 30 overs bowled in the afternoon session! It was tough work for Zimbabwe as they didn't get enough support from the surface. Still, the likes of Victor Nyauchi and Carl Mumba showed their talent and managed to beat the outside edge on a few occasions. The major disappointment for the home team has been the performance of the debutant Tinotenda Mutombodzi. The leggie struggled with his line and length and as a result failed to reap rewards from the responsive pitch. It's easy going for the Lankans currently and apart from a dropped catch of Oshada Fernando, it's been a chance-less partnership so far. They would look to continue in the same manner and end the day's play without any casualties. Do join us at 1500 local (1300 GMT) for the last session.
A slider around off, it's defended off the front foot. TEA ON DAY 2 and Sri Lanka trail by 318 runs!
Flighted ball wide outside off, left alone.
Play and a miss! Raza slows this one in the air and serves it on a fuller length outside off. Karunaratne is lured into the shot and is beaten by the away spin.
Full and flighted on off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Too full in length on middle, Dimuth works it on the leg side but finds short mid-wicket on this occasion.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it to short cover.
Beauty! Mumba lands it on a length and just outside off, holding its line, Fernando feels for it inside the line and misses.
Short and wide outside off, Fernando cuts but finds point. Misses out on a gift.
In the channel outside off, Fernando pokes at it and misses.
Outside off, left alone.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Karunaratne uses the angle and works it through backward square leg for a run.

Appeal for an lbw! Raza gets good turn and bounce from around middle, Oshada strides forward to defend but misses. He is pinged on the front pad, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Missing leg.
Presses forward to a full ball and tries to defend. It takes the inner half and lands in front of short leg.
Lets the ball spin back into him and works it behind square leg. Finds the fielder.
Tossed up ball on off, defended back to the bowler.

Takes a good calculative risk! Flighted ball around off, spinning away, Karunaratne dances down the track and flicks it over mid-wicket. It doesn't have the legs to cross the fence and the batsmen take three.
Very full in length on middle, it's driven back to the bowler.
Fractionally short in length and close to off, Karunaratne gets inside the line and nudges it to long leg for one.
Short and wide outside off, left alone.
Beaten! A length ball just outside off and holding its line, Dimuth plays inside the line and misses.
Shortish again, outside off, Oshada steers it wide of point and his partner calls him through for a single.
Stays back to a short delivery and punches it to cover-point.
Short in length around middle and leg, Karunaratne pulls it to fine leg and collects a single.
Gets back and pushes it back to the bowler who parries it towards mid off.
Oshada has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Allows the ball to spin back in from around off and taps it down in front of short leg.
Quicker one, full and around leg, helped behind square leg.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it to mid off for a single.
Flatter and shorter outside off, cut from the back foot but straight to cover-point.
A touch short in length around off, Dimuth stands back and turns it through backward square leg for a single.
Bouncer around middle and leg, Karunaratne ducks underneath it.

Mistimed! Short in length, Dimuth collects it from outside off with the intention to pull it across the line. Fails to middle his shot properly and it goes on one drop to the short mid-wicket fielder.
A back foot punch again by Karunaratne but he finds silly mid off.
Back of a length ball around off, Dimuth moves back inside the crease and pushes it back. The bowler collects it in his followthrough.
Good length ball close to off, angling in, Karunaratne covers the line and pushes it to short cover.

Very full in length around middle, it's knocked down to mid on where the fielder dives and only manages to make a half stop. It rolls behind and the long on fielder cleans it up. They cross for a single.
Pitches it up and outside off, Karunaratne plays a lovely drive but finds short cover.
Flighted delivery, full and around off, Dimuth is on the front foot in defense.
A gentle off spinner just outside off, Karunaratne covers his stumps and then makes a leave.
Nicely played! Too full in length on middle, Fernando executes a reverse sweep behind backward point and collects three runs.
Floated off spinner landing full around off, Oshada strides forward and defends it off the inner half to short leg.
Slips a length ball around middle and leg, angling down, Karunaratne tries flicking but misses. Good take by Chakabva.
Fractionally short and close to off, Dimuth stands back inside the line and defends it towards the bowler.
Digs in a short ball on off, Oshada turns inside the crease and pulls it down to fine leg for a run.
Similar to the last delivery. Short and wide outside off, Oshada flashes his bat through the line but fails to middle his shot. Finds point. That was an attempted off cutter by Mumba!
Back of a length delivery outside off, Fernando follows the ball and tries to steer it past point. Bottom edges it and the ball rolls towards backward point.
Begins a new spell with a fuller length ball on off, Oshada defends it back off his front foot.
Carl Mumba is brought back into the attack. 5-1-17-0 are his figures so far. A slip in place.
Steps down the track a bit and flicks it on the leg side. Finds short mid-wicket. Maiden from Raza!
Loopy full ball landing around middle, Karunaratne presses forward in defense.
Skiddy delivery, wide outside off, Dimuth lets it be.
Quicker full ball on middle, it's pushed down to mid on.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Play and a miss! Flatter and shorter outside off, Dimuth tries to cut but misses.
Sikandar Raza (2-0-7-0) takes over from this end.
Fullish delivery, wide outside off, Fernando stretches his front leg forward and then makes a leave.
Gentle hands, good calling and a run is pinched. A length ball around off, Karunaratne taps it down towards wide mid on and scampers across to the other end.
Back of a length ball on off, Dimuth jumps back inside the crease and turns it in front of square leg.
Nyauchi switches to 'round the wicket and angles in a full ball on middle, Karunaratne works it off his pads to silly mid on.
Fullish and on middle, Karunaratne brings down a straight bat as he pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Karunaratne has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Third full toss in the over and this too has been punished. Outside off, Fernando latches onto it and drills it through the gap at mid off and extra cover for a boundary. Mutombodzi is struggling big time and it seems that he is not completing his bowling action well. 26 off his 4 overs so far.
Too full in length and outside off, Oshada drives but finds mid off.
Quicker and flatter on leg, it's flicked through backward square leg for one.
FOUR! Easily done! Yet another full toss has been dished out, Karunaratne fetches it from outside off and swings it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted and full on middle, Dimuth flicks but finds short mid-wicket.
It appears to be a real struggle for the debutant. Starts a new over with a full toss outside off and gets away with it. It's punched to sweeper cover for just a single.
A length delivery on off, Dimuth sticks back to defend and does so from the inner half of his blade. A good probing over by Nyauchi.
Again goes past the outside edge. On a length and around off, Karunaratne shows zero footwork as he pokes inside the line and misses.
Too full in length around leg, Karunaratne clips it off his pads and pierces the gap between two fielders standing in front of square leg. The batsmen take a couple of runs.
Beaten this time! Every now and then this has happened. Nyauchi takes a length ball away with the angle. Since it's close to off, Dimuth feels for it but only to get beaten.
Wicket to wicket line this time. Fuller in length and Karunaratne presses forward to defend it on the leg side.
A touch short in length and close to off, Karunaratne hangs back to cut but finds point.

Short this time, flat and on middle, skidding down, Oshada turns to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects to fine leg and they steal a couple of runs. Mutombodzi yet to settle into any kind of rhythm.
Quick delivery, flatter and wide outside off, it's left alone by the batsman.
Loopy and fullish on off, Fernando slices his attempted drive towards backward point. All along the ground and it's safe.
Goes quicker and flatter through the air this time. Once again the length is on the shorter side and Karunaratne helps it behind square leg for a run.

FOUR! Poor, very poor from the leggie. Fails to get his length right this time. Drops it short and around off, Karunaratne moves inside the crease and pulls it powerfully behind square leg for a boundary.
Very full in length on middle, not allowing the ball time to grip and spin, Karunaratne flicks but finds mid-wicket.
Our assumption was correct. Change of ends for Tinotenda Mutombodzi.
Targets the off stump line with a fuller length delivery, Oshada is solidly behind the line as he defends it off his front foot.
Pitches it up and close to off, angling in, Fernando gets forward and defends it near his front pad.
Serves a length delivery in the channel outside off, Oshada covers his sticks and shoulders arms.
Strides forward to a length ball and pushes it to short cover.
Straighter delivery, on a length, it's worked with the angle of the bowler to the leg side. Finds mid-wicket.
Fullish and angling in around off, Oshada has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Victor Nyauchi (4-1-9-0) is back on. Maybe, the debutant leggie will be having a change of ends.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Slows it up in the air this time, full and around off, Karunaratne prods forward in defense.
Once again Raza is quicker through the air as he darts in a full ball on middle, Dimuth drives it off his front foot to mid on.
Too full and on middle, knocked down the ground but straight to mid on.
Well played! Flatter full ball around off, Fernando brings out the reverse sweep and nails it in the direction of third man. It slows down before the rope and the batsmen collect three runs.
Short in length and turning down the leg side, Oshada goes deep inside the crease and helps it towards square leg.

Drinks break. Easy going for Sri Lanka. Their openers have settled down and slowly but steadily building a solid partnership. Zimbabwe have tried hard but without much success. There was a dropped catch which was offered by Oshada Fernando and they will be ruing that. Let's see how the next hour progresses. Sikandar Raza to inaugurate it.

Shout for a caught behind! The umpire stays unmoved. A flatter delivery is fired down the leg side, the Lankan skipper tries to flick but fails to middle his shot. Chakabva collects the ball and they all appeal in unison. The umpire is not bothered and turns to call for Drinks.
Fullish and on middle, worked in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
A googly this time but the line is outside leg, Dimuth tickles it behind square leg for one. 50-run stand comes up!
Steps down the track to smother the spin but flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Some spin on this occasion. Nicely flighted and pitched on a fuller length around off, Karunaratne drew forward to defend but it takes the inner half and rolls to short leg.
An attempted leg spinner but the length is very full outside off, Oshada drives it with ease to sweeper cover for a run.
Length ball on off, defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Victor bowls one on a length and brings the ball into the batsman. Karunaratne looks to flick it but the ball does not come in as expected and it goes uppishly between square leg and mid-wicket.
Fuller in length and around off, driven staight to mid on.
Length and on off, Dimuth presents the full face of the bat and defends it to the off side.
Full ball on off, driven to mid on.
Full on off, Dimuth drives with the straightest of bats and finds the stumps at the other end.
Tossed up on off, pushed to covers.
Flatter on off, punched to the off side.
Fernando drives this tossed up ball straight to mid off.
Full on off, driven to mid on for a single.
FOUR! Short ball down the leg side and Karunaratne pulls it through fine leg for a boundary.
Starts with a full toss outside off, Fernando pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Debutant Tinotenda Mutombodzi is on now. He is a leg spinner and let's see how much spin he gets from this surface.
Full on the pads, Dimuth flicks it to fine leg for a couple.
Down the leg side, Dimuth looks to lay bat on ball but misses it. The keeper does the rest.
Dimuth defends this length ball off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, pushed to the leg side.
Good length and on the pads, flicked to short mid-wicket.
Length and on off, tapped to short cover.
Closer to middle and off, Fernando plays it with the angle of the bowler and keeps it out safely towards mid-wicket. Maiden!
Play and a miss! A good length delivery outside off, nipping away a shade after landing, Oshada tries to get near to the line of the ball but ends up pushing and missing due to the away movement.
On a driving length outside off with some away movement on it, Fernando doesn't get committed into the shot. That's the line and length to probe with. Play on the patience of the batsman.
Donald gets fuller on this occasion. He drops it close to off and Oshada defends it off his front foot towards mid on. Lovely straight bat!
This time Tiripano brings a length ball back into the batsman from around off, Fernando is forced to play the line and he helps it towards mid-wicket.
Hurls in a length delivery in the zone outside off, Oshada strides forward to cover his stumps and then allows it through to the keeper.
Length and on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket. Dot ball to end the over where Zimbabwe should have got the breakthrough!
Length ball outside off, Oshada slaps it through covers and the ball races towards the fence. The fielder from covers gives the chase and mops it up. The batsmen get three runs with ease.
Back of a length ball outside off, Fernando defends it to point off the back foot.
Length and outside off, Fernando defends it off the front foot.
Fernando blocks it off the front foot to the off side.

Oh! DROPPED! Nyauchi almost gets the first one only to be denied by the drop from the keeper.
