Victor bowls one on the pads and Fernando looks to flick it but he cannot get it from the middle of the bat and inside edges it behind. Chakabva there dives to his left but spills the chance as the ball hits his gloves and drops on the ground. How costly will this prove for Zimbabwe?

Tiripano strays one down the leg side and Fernando misses his flick too. The keeper fumbles to take that cleanly as he parries it towards short fine leg. The batsmen take a run. Byes signaled by the umpire.
Way outside off, Fernando shoulders arms to it.
Back of a length ball outside off, tapped towards covers.
Outside off, pushed to the off side.
Length and on middle, flicked to mid on for a quick run.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven to point.
Length ball on off, defended to the off side off.
Another outside off ball and Oshada lets it be.
Fernando is not fiddling with outside off deliveries.
Outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Once again Fernando gets an edge. Victor bowls one on a length and outside off, Fernando looks to push it off the back foot but gets an outside edge. The ball just bounces in front of second slip and goes to the fence behind.
Length ball outside off, defended towards gully.
Victor Nyauchi is on now.
Dimuth is happy to not play at a ball outside off.
Length ball outside off, with a hint of shape in. But not enough to make the batsman play.
Good length ball outside off, Dimuth leaves it.
Outside off, Karunaratne lets it go.
Back of a length ball outside off, Dimuth goes for the cut but fails to time it and the ball rolls towards the off side.
Length and on off, Karunaratne blocks it off the front foot.
Outside off, Fernando looks to lay bat on ball but gets beaten.
FOUR! Too straight on the pads, easy pickings for Fernando as he helps it on its way to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Way outside off, Fernando goes chasing at it. The ball goes past the outside edge and bounces in front of the keeper before he takes it.
Length ball just outside off, Oshada Fernando plays inside the line and the ball goes past the outside edge.
Fuller in length and just outside off, Oshada blocks it solidly off the front foot.
Length and outside off, left alone.
FOUR LEG BYES! Poor line again. Down the leg side on a good length, Karunaratne tries flicking but misses. It takes his thigh pad and runs very straight past the keeper for a boundary at fine leg.
Fuller in length and outside off, Karunaratne tries driving through the line but it takes the inner half and rolls back to the bowler.
Width on offer outside off, DK packs a punch but picks out point.
Slips a full length ball down the leg side, Karunaratne fails to flick and it goes off his pads to fine leg for a couple of leg byes.
Short and outside off, Dimuth goes to cut but it takes the outer half and drops towards gully.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
EDGY FOUR! Fernando looks to push this length ball through the off side but gets an outside edge on it. The ball flies past the slip cordon on its way to the third man fence for a boundary.
Length ball defended off the back foot.

Once again Karunaratne drives but fails to find the fence. Mumba bowls one on a length outside off, Dimuth drives it through covers and the fielder there gives the chase. He stops the ball just inside the rope. The batsmen get three.
This time he drives this length ball towards covers.
Karunaratne drives this full ball towards covers. The fielder there fumbles and the ball goes through him. A couple is what the batsmen get.
Full and down the leg side. Fernando looks to flick it but misses. The keeper dives to his left but the ball goes past him towards fine leg. The batsmen steal a run. Byes given.
Straighter delivery, the Lankan skipper uses his wrists and works it to square leg. Maiden!
Pitches it up and outside off, Karunaratne drives it with good timing but picks out mid off.
This one is way wide outside off to tempt the batsman.
In the channel outside off, on a length, Dimuth shoulders arms.
Edgy! Good length delivery outside off, Karunaratne tries to glide it down past point but it takes the outer half of his bat and rolls in front of gully-point.
Full and outside off, Dimuth looks to defend it but gets it off the outside half of the bat. The ball goes towards covers.
Fernando flicks this full ball towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on off, punched off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, defended off the front foot.
Full ball on off, Fernando looks to drive once again but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The bowler appeals but aborts quickly.
Full outside off, Fernando creams the drive through covers. The ball stops inside the rope due to the slow outfield and the batsmen get a couple.
Length ball on off, Fernando blocks it with the full face of the bat.
Length and wide outside off, left alone.
Full and too straight from Tiripano, the batsman flicks it behind square leg for a couple.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, angling away, Karunaratne sticks back and has a needless push inside the line. He is beaten by the angle.
Fernando plays this length ball with an open face towards third man for a single.
Good length ball on off, defended off the back foot towards covers.
Full and on off, blocked off the front foot.

We are back after the break. The Zimbabwean players would be really happy with their performance with the bat. Now it's their bowlers who have to rise to the occasion. The Sri Lanka openers Dimuth Karunaratne and Oshada Fernando negotiated the three overs before Lunch break and are back in the middle to fight it out. Just for your information, Sean Williams is down with flu and we are assuming that Brendan Taylor is leading the team currently as the home team has not announced any vice captain. Donald Tiripano to bowl...
... DAY 2, SESSION 2 ...

Three tricky overs safely negotiated by Sri Lanka! Nothing much you can read on their batting or Zimbabwe's bowling from that. But if we consider the entire first session, there is something in the surface to assist the spinners. Do join us at 1240 local (1040 GMT) for the second session.
Blocked off the front foot towards the off side. That will be LUNCH ON DAY 2!
BEATEN! Karunaratne goes behind a wide delivery outside off which is further going away. The ball beats the outside edge and the keeper takes it.
Tossed up ball on off, Dimuth skips down the track and defends it towards covers.
Flatter on the stumps, blocked off the back foot.
Floated on middle, defended off the front foot.
Full on middle and leg, tucked to the leg side off the back foot.
Flighted on off, Fernando defends it off the front foot.
Floated on leg, tucked towards the leg side.
Fernando tucks this flatter one on leg towards the leg side for a couple.
Full on the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Floated down the leg side, Fernando lets it be.
Full and on the pads, Fernando tucks it towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Outside off, Karunaratne leaves it alone.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Karunaratne tucks it off the pads towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, left alone.
Once again, blocked off the front foot to the off side.
Tossed up on off, defended off the front foot.
Tossed up ball outside off, Karunaratne drives it through covers. Sri Lanka are off the mark with a couple.
